an4.191:1.1: Sotānugatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ cattāro ānisaṃsā pātikaṅkhā.
an4.191:1.5: Tassa te dhammā sotānugatā honti vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:1.6: So muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ uppajjati.
an4.191:1.7: Tassa tattha sukhino dhammapadāni pi lapanti.
an4.191:1.9: atha so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:1.10: Sotānugatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā . . . diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ayaṃ paṭhamo ānisaṃso paṭikaṅkho. 2.
an4.191:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti,
an4.191:2.3: Tassa te dhammā sotānugatā honti . . . suppaṭividdhā.
an4.191:2.4: So muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ uppajjati.
an4.191:2.5: Tassa tattha na h' eva kho sukhino dhammapadāni pi lapanti,
an4.191:2.6: api ca kho bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:2.8: ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo yatthāhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarin ti.
an4.191:2.10: atha kho so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:2.13: tassa na h' eva kho assa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā
an4.191:2.14: bherisaddo nu kho na nu kho bherisaddo ti,
an4.191:2.15: atha kho bherisaddo t' eva niṭṭhaṃ gaccheyya,
an4.191:2.16: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.191:2.26: Sotānugatānaṃ bhikkhave . . . diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho. 3.
an4.191:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti . . . [ 2]
an4.191:3.5: na pi bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti,
an4.191:3.6: api ca kho devaputto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
an4.191:3.8: ayaṃ vāso dhammavinayo yatthāhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarin ti.
an4.191:3.10: atha kho so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoṭi.
an4.191:3.13: tassa na h' eva kho assa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā
an4.191:3.14: saṅkhasaddo nu kho na nu kho saṅkhasaddo ti,
an4.191:3.15: atha kho saṅkhasaddo t' eva niṭṭhaṃ gaccheyya,
an4.191:3.16: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.191:3.26: Sotānugatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ manasānupekkhitānaṃ diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhānaṃ ayaṃ tatiyo ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho. 4.
an4.191:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammam pariyāpuṇāti
an4.191:4.5: na pi bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti na pi devaputto devaparisāya dhammaṃ deseti,
an4.191:4.6: api ca kho opapātiko opapātikaṃ sāreti:
an4.191:4.7: sarasi tvaṃ mārisa sarasi tvaṃ mārisa yattha mayaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarimhāti?
an4.191:4.11: atha kho so satto khippaṃ yeva visesagāmī hoti.
an4.191:4.14: tam enaṃ sahāyako sahāyakaṃ evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.191:4.15: idam pi samma sarasi idam pi me samma sarasīti?
an4.191:4.18: evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu . . . pe . . .
an4.191:4.29: Sotanugatānaṃ bhikkhave . . . suppaṭividdhānam ayaṃ catuttho ānisaṃso pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.191:4.30: Sotānugatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ . . . suppaṭividdhānaṃ ime cattāro ānisaṃsā pāṭikaṅkhā ti. 192. 1.
